recommendations.action: Make the plan criteria name the requirements they prove. Stories 2.1 to 2.4 list their criteria in the plan without `R` ids (only story 3 AC-5 names one), and story 2.5 has an empty `covers`, so 19 of 20 criteria are unlinked exception rows and R1, R2, R3 and R4 have no passing contributor. Add `(R1, R2)` style tags to the plan criteria (or give story 2.5 a `covers`), then re-run the trace. This is the only change needed to move the gate on the requirements; it alters no behaviour.

Record the human check that `eval` is a required check on main (story 3 AC-5, R3) in `live-verification-results.json` against the commit under trace. Nothing else establishes the Done-when line for the blocking check.

Resolve story 1 AC-1 and story 2 AC-1's diff clauses. Story 1's `git diff b7be713 -- tests/eval_oracle.py is empty` is false at HEAD because story 2.2 appended the cluster oracle (72 added lines, none removed). Either pin the red-commit content with a test (for example a hash of the original oracle block) or amend the criterion by a PO replan. For story 2 AC-1, record the empty diff against 7ea485a as a live result or pin it in a test.

Record the CI run results as live evidence for story 1 AC-4, story 3 AC-4 and story 5's verify clauses. PR #31's checks all passed (`checks`, `eval / deploy`, `integrated-check / deploy`) and `eval/baseline.json` is unchanged across it, but the trace counts only recorded results at the commit under trace.
Fix the `pytest.mark.criterion` markers on `tests/eval/test_eval_kind.py` (lines 44, 110, 120, 132, 141): they cite `ticketscope--e2-s1--AC-1` while their assertions establish AC-2 and AC-5.
Waiver W-001's remediation (epic 2 Done-when line) is still open: a fresh epic 1 trace does not yet honour the six superseded criteria. Check it at epic closure; owner Dillon.
